cited.quote: Payment of compensation for the damages caused by wildlife

rationale: C1 sanctions funds for wildlife damage compensation, a separate state compensation scheme, not an order extending the crop insurance scheme (C3, C5 cover only RPMFBY for existing perils). No order expanding crop insurance to wildlife damage is shown.

cited.quote: every case / proposal of compensation for loss of crops/damage to property by wild animals

rationale: C1 is a fund sanction and an instruction to officers to scrutinise crop-loss compensation cases under an existing scheme; it does not issue claim guidelines for farmers. C4 and C5 only state that compensation is paid. No new guidelines shown.

cited.quote: the Government hereby constitute the Fifth Police Commission with the following composition

rationale: C1 is the GO of 2022-02-16 constituting the Fifth Police Commission, so the constitution part is done. Nothing in the extracts shows the Commission's recommendations were submitted or implemented.

cited.quote: pump sets and generators for permanent remedial measures to tackle inundation of flood

rationale: Only C5 mentions generators, for highway flood restoration, not for police stations, hospitals or revenue offices. Other extracts are flood and police budget statements. No official step for the promised generators is shown.

None of the extracts concerns the Tamil Nadu Damage to Public Property Act or punishment for destroying public property with hazardous materials; they cover climate company, safety rules and building rules.

cited.quote: 8 gram gold coin along with cash assistance of Rs.50,000/- for the graduates and diploma holders

rationale: C3 and C2 describe the Orphan Girls scheme with 8 gram gold coin and Rs.25,000 cash for non-graduates, unchanged from before. No order raising the assistance to Rs.30,000 is shown.

cited.quote: Wi-fi/LAN, smart class, Learning Management System, audio video recording facilities etc., were not available

rationale: C1 (audit) notes Wi-fi was not available in sampled college classrooms. C5 covers hi-tech labs and smart classrooms, and C3 a telecom policy, neither a Wi-fi order for educational institutions. No official step shown.

cited.quote: Mega Sports City with facilities of world class standard for various sports disciplines
has been requested to select Consultants to prepare Techno – Economic Feasibility Report

rationale: C2 reports a Mega Sports City near Chennai with world-class facilities for various disciplines, and TIDCO asked to select consultants for a feasibility report. This is a preparatory step only, not operational. Match to Games Village is close but not exact.

cited.quote: Stamp duty of 5% and registration fee of 4% 15 are collected for the deeds of Sale, Exchange and Gift.

rationale: C5 shows the standard stamp duty and registration fee on deeds including Gift, with no reduction for transfers between blood relatives. Other extracts concern COVID orphans and medical rates. No official step shown.

cited.quote: The employees recruited on or before 31.03.2003 are covered under the above pension scheme.

rationale: C1 says the existing pension scheme covers only employees recruited on or before 31.03.2003. C2 and C3 raise the retirement age, not restore a pension scheme for all transport employees. No step for the promise is shown.

cited.quote: in lieu of existing 1281 Causeways, High Level Bridges will be constructed at a cost of Rs.2401 crore

rationale: C5 is the 2021-12-16 GO of administrative sanction under CRIDP citing high level bridges in lieu of 1281 causeways, with 648 taken up initially. This covers part of the promised conversion, not all. C1 shows other bridge works in progress.

cited.quote: will be implemented to benefit handloom weavers in the State, with a total allocation of Rs.490.27 crore in 2021-22

rationale: C3 is a budget statement that the free saree and dhoti scheme will be implemented to benefit handloom weavers. No GO or award of weaving contracts to weavers is shown; C2 only describes Co-optex distribution. Not an operational step.

cited.quote: Declaration of Kazhuveli Swamp / Wetland situated in Vanur and Marakkanam Taluks of Villupuram District as Kazhuveli Birds Sanctuary

rationale: C4 notifies a new bird sanctuary, a related but different action. C2 and C3 describe the wildlife forensic institute, not ornithology centres in bird sanctuaries. No step for ornithology centres is shown.

cited.quote: the Government will introduce necessary legislation to ensure that the students of Tamil Nadu are not adversely affected by NEET

rationale: C1 is the Governor's address stating the intent to introduce legislation and seek the President's consent. No extract shows a bill, a resolution or any step to obtain the consent. C2 to C5 are unrelated orders.
No extract is about a one-day holiday or weekly off for police personnel. C4 mentions Sunday holidays only for new reception staff, C5 a poll-day holiday, C3 festival holidays, C1 labour rules.

cited.quote: As on 31.3.2021, there are 4,52,777 pending applications under various categories.

rationale: C1 and C2 describe agricultural connection schemes under registration priority, and C2 reports 4,52,777 pending applications. No order giving immediate connection to all applicants is shown.

cited.quote: Enhancement of compensation for the loss of human life or permanent incapaciation from 4.00 lakhs to Rs.5.00 lakhs

rationale: C1 is the GO dated 2021-11-03 enhancing compensation for loss of human life in human-wildlife conflict to Rs.5.00 lakhs. The existing amount was Rs.4.00 lakhs rather than 3, but the promised Rs.5 lakh was reached.
No extract concerns purchase of power from agricultural biomass fuel producers under a PPP model. C1 lists general power purchase agreements; C3 to C5 are copra procurement.

No extract concerns spoken English coaching for government school children with the British Council or similar institutions. C1 is a UNICEF life skills programme; C3 and C5 are competitive exam coaching on TV.

No extract concerns foreign language courses in colleges and universities. C1 covers soft skill and Communicative English courses, a different subject. Other extracts are about coaching, grading and faculty rules.
